key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: SUDDEN onset within hours to days. LOCATION: GENERALIZED symptoms. DURATION: Develops over hours to days. CHARACTER: SEVERE headache, neck stiffness, fever. AGGRAVATING: LIGHT, sound, movement. RELIEVING: ANTIBIOTICS, supportive care. TIMING: Sudden onset, develops over hours to days. SEVERITY: 8-10/10, severe and unrelenting. ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: SEVERE HEADACHE, neck stiffness, fever, photophobia, nausea, vomiting, may have altered mental status. KEY POSITIVES: Severe headache, neck stiffness, fever, photophobia, positive Kernig sign, positive Brudzinski sign. KEY NEGATIVES: No focal neurological deficits.

red_flags: Severe neurological deficits with altered mental status - possible severe meningitis, call 911
Signs of increased intracranial pressure - severe headache, vomiting, altered mental status - call 911
Severe hypertension with neurological deficits - possible hypertensive crisis, call 911
Signs of brainstem involvement - dysphagia, dysarthria, ataxia - call 911
Signs of respiratory failure - difficulty breathing, cyanosis, altered mental status - call 911
